name: Go defect repair
description: A bounded reproduce-fix-verify workflow for Go defects.

steps.instruction: Inspect go.mod/go.work, repository instructions, the failing path, nearby tests, and generated-file markers. Reproduce the narrow failure when practical and identify the violated invariant before editing.

Add or strengthen a regression test for the root cause, then make the smallest complete fix. Preserve public compatibility and existing package boundaries; avoid unrelated refactors and new dependencies.

Format every touched Go file, run the focused regression test, then run exactly `go test ./...`. Also run exactly `go vet ./...` when supported. If concurrency changed, run exactly `go test -race ./...`; report any check that could not run.
